products.name: Green tea
products.text:
NAGI · Nagi
A chilled bottle of green tea. Thuan keeps the oldest stock at the front.

purpose.why: The everyday bottle: with lunch, on a hot walk, on the verandah.
purpose.placed: First column, eye level: the drink most people come in for is the first one they see.

products.name: Canned coffee
products.text:
PORT 88 · Port88
A small can of coffee for the walk down to the harbour.

purpose.why: A sweet canned coffee before a dawn shift or between rounds.
purpose.placed: Under the tea, where a working hand reaches without looking.

products.name: Spring water
products.text: Water from the hills above the harbour.

purpose.why: Spring water for runs, patrols and long afternoons on the quay.
purpose.placed: Second column, eye level: the second most asked-for drink.

purpose.why: Mandarin juice for a child’s lunch, or a breakfast in a hurry.
purpose.placed: Low in the juice column, at a child’s reach.

back.ingredients: Sugars, carbonation, caramel colour, acidulant, flavouring, caffeine

purpose.why: A cold cola after school or a shift.
purpose.placed: Eye level in the third column: the impulse drink.

purpose.why: Ramune with the marble: the summer drink children ask for by name.
purpose.placed: Low under the cola, where children look.

purpose.why: For the morning tea, the children, and the bathhouse fridge when it runs out.
purpose.placed: Top of the last column: for people who knew what they came for.

products.name: Umineko lager
products.text: A chilled can of the local fictional lager.

purpose.why: Umineko lager for the evening at home, the boat, or the walk to Minato.
purpose.placed: The column nearest the till: beer is the last thing picked up, and Thuan sees who buys it.

products.name: Plum rice ball
products.text:
SAKURA · Sakura knot
Rice, a little pickled plum and a strip of nori. Wrapped this afternoon.

purpose.why: The lunch eaten standing up: plum onigiri, made this afternoon.
purpose.placed: Eye level in the chiller: the shop’s best seller where nobody has to look for it.

back.ingredients: Rice, grilled salmon, rolled omelette, fried chicken, simmered vegetables, pickles

purpose.why: A proper lunch for people who cannot leave their work: the power house, the workshop, the office.
purpose.placed: Under the rice balls: the dearer lunch beside the cheap one.

purpose.why: Egg sandwiches eaten at a desk or on the ferry.
purpose.placed: Middle bay, eye level, over the bread it is made from.

back.ingredients: Wheat flour, milk, sugar, butter, yeast, salt

purpose.why: Milk bread for tomorrow’s breakfast.
purpose.placed: Under the sandwiches: the household buy below the snack.

purpose.why: A small treat: after homework, after a long shelf, after the bath.
purpose.placed: Top deck of the last bay: the treat at eye level, where it is hard to walk past.

purpose.why: Plain yoghurt for a light breakfast and a careful stomach.
purpose.placed: Under the pudding, for the people with good intentions.

products.name: Instant shoyu noodles
products.text: A sealed cup of noodles to take home.

back.ingredients: Fried noodles (wheat flour, vegetable oil, salt), soup (soy sauce, salt, spices), toppings (naruto, spring onion)

purpose.why: Cup noodles for a late night or a typhoon day indoors.
purpose.placed: Pantry, front face: quick food first.

back.ingredients: Miso, wakame, spring onion, tofu, bonito extract

purpose.why: Miso sachets for one bowl when cooking a pot is too much.
purpose.placed: Beside the noodles: the other thing you add hot water to.

back.ingredients: Wheat flour, beef fat, curry powder, salt, sugar, spices

purpose.why: Curry roux for a family dinner; Mrs Sato swears it is not for the shop.
purpose.placed: Pantry, front face, low: a heavy box for a cook who comes back every week.

purpose.why: Soy sauce for a kitchen that ran out mid-service.
purpose.placed: Pantry, back face: the staple, found by people who already know where it is.

back.ingredients: Tuna, soybean oil, salt, vegetable extract

purpose.why: Tinned tuna for onigiri at home and for the cat that is not officially fed.
purpose.placed: Back face, with the other tins.

purpose.why: Tinned peaches for visiting someone who is ill, as one does.
purpose.placed: Back face, high: an occasional buy, not in the way.

purpose.why: Salted crisps with a beer or a baseball game on the radio.
purpose.placed: Front face at a grown-up’s eye, seen on the way back from the beer.

purpose.why: Soy rice crackers with tea, for visitors.
purpose.placed: Front face, the low boards: a big bag for visitors, easy to lift down, under the crisps.

products.name: Butter biscuits
products.text:
KOMOREBI · Komorebi
A paper packet of biscuits. The corner is folded closed with care.

back.ingredients: Wheat flour, butter, sugar, egg, salt

purpose.why: Butter biscuits for a reading afternoon or a night at the press.
purpose.placed: Front face, top: the gift-sized packet where it can be seen.

back.ingredients: Sugar, cocoa mass, whole milk powder, cocoa butter, flavouring

purpose.why: Milk chocolate after school.
purpose.placed: Back face, low: at a child’s eye, below a parent’s.

back.ingredients: Sugar, glucose syrup, fruit juice, acidulant, flavouring, colour

purpose.why: Fruit sweets, the ten-yen kind of treat.
purpose.placed: The lowest shelf of the back face, where small hands find it first.

purpose.why: Laundry powder: the bathhouse towels and a family’s week.
purpose.placed: Bottom of the front face: the heaviest thing in the shop, low and near the door out.

products.name: Sakura soap
products.text:
HANAMORI · Hanamori
A lightly scented bar wrapped in pale pink paper.

purpose.why: Sakura soap for the bath and the shop’s own washroom.
purpose.placed: Above the detergent: washing beside washing.

purpose.why: Tissues for hay fever, a cold, or a sad film.
purpose.placed: Front face, next bay: bulky and light, at hand height.

back.ingredients: Calcium carbonate, glycerin, flavouring, sodium fluoride

purpose.why: Mint toothpaste, the thing you notice has run out at night.
purpose.placed: Above the tissues, with the bathroom.

products.name: Radio batteries
products.text:
HOSHIMARU · Hoshimaru
Two dry-cell batteries. Ask before fitting them to the shop radio.

purpose.why: Dry cells for radios, torches and the harbour lamp.
purpose.placed: Back face, nearest the till: small, dear and easy to pocket, so Thuan can see them.

products.name: Pocket notebook
products.text:
SHIOFUMI · Shiofumi
Ruled pages for tide times, errands and things you meant to remember.

back.ingredients: Fine paper · 30 sheets · 7mm ruled · sewn binding

purpose.why: Pocket notebooks for tide times, articles and homework.
purpose.placed: Beside the batteries: stationery with the small things.

products.name: Harbour postcard
products.text:
SHIOFUMI · Shiofumi
A printed view of the old breakwater. Thuan knows the photographer.

back.ingredients: Postcard · a morning on the harbour

purpose.why: Harbour postcards for visitors and for letters to the main island.
purpose.placed: Back face, by the till, beside the stamps Thuan sells.

products.name: Steamed pork bun
products.text: A wrapped steamed bun to take away.

back.ingredients: Wheat flour, pork, onion, soy sauce, sugar

purpose.why: A steamed pork bun to eat walking out of the door.
purpose.placed: In the steamer on the counter: smelt while paying, bought on impulse.

prints.what: Sakura's delivery carton: the cartons on the delivery shelf, by the back door and in the back room.
Sakura Shōten's own mark, painted on the first packaging sheet; nothing on the floor carries it yet.
A monthly for the rack under the window: read standing up, never sold.
A weekly for the rack under the window: read standing up, never sold.
The fishing monthly for the rack under the window: read standing up, never sold.
The Minato Shimbun's evening edition, on the rack and in the comics.
